meta.title: Hotel Revenue Management & Distribution | HotelMinds
meta.description: Improve hotel revenue management, pricing, booking platforms and direct sales with hands-on strategy and implementation from HotelMinds.

hero.headline: Improve Revenue. Protect Margin. Gain Commercial Control.
hero.subheader: HotelMinds helps independent hotels strengthen revenue management, pricing, online sales and direct bookings - with clear strategy and hands-on execution.

areas.headline: The areas that directly influence revenue, conversion and margin.

bullets.text: Improve how your hotel is positioned across major booking platforms such as Booking.com and Expedia, metasearch platforms including Google, Trivago and Tripadvisor, and increase its chances of being discovered through ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
Strengthen revenue management, room and rate structures and the booking journey to turn more existing demand into profitable reservations.
Align pricing, availability and sales channels to reduce unnecessary discounting, inconsistencies and margin leakage.
Use booking patterns, market developments, channel performance and reporting to turn data into clear commercial actions.

services.headline: Commercial performance is rarely lost in one place.

bullets.text: Small weaknesses across pricing, distribution, direct sales and commercial systems can gradually reduce revenue and margin.
Rates are adjusted without a clear revenue strategy.
Promotions and discounts become the default way to generate bookings.
Too little demand converts through the hotel’s own website.
Pricing, availability, content and technology are not aligned.
Reporting shows what happened, but not what should happen next.

results.headline: Move from reactive decisions to a more controlled commercial setup.

steps.title: Typical Starting Point
bullets: Limited visibility on what actually drives results

steps.title: Target Setup
bullets: Better control over rates and availability

process.headline: From diagnosis to implementation.
process.intro: Our structured approach begins with a comprehensive Audit & Diagnosis to uncover hidden revenue potential. We then translate these insights into a Strategic Roadmap with a clear 6–9 month action plan, ensuring long-term growth through disciplined Implementation & Monitoring.

bullets.title: Audit & Diagnosis
bullets.text: We review pricing, revenue management, booking channels, direct sales and commercial systems to identify the most important gaps and opportunities.

bullets.title: Strategic Roadmap
bullets.text: We turn the findings into a clear, prioritized action plan focused on the changes that matter most.

bullets.title: Implementation & Monitoring
bullets.text: We support execution, monitor performance and adjust the approach as demand and market conditions change.

finalCta.headline: Take Control of Your Revenue and Profitability.
finalCta.text: Let’s identify where revenue, margin or booking potential is being lost - and what should change first.
